title: Tôi quên đồ rồi
summary: Say "I left something behind" with Tôi quên đồ rồi, then use the notes below to adjust tone and next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi quên đồ rồi answers the traveler question "I left something behind" in lost items, help, managers, and recovery moments. Say this if you forgot an item in a car, room, or café. This is a common hotel, taxi, and café recovery phrase. Its job is naming the concrete item or problem first so staff can choose the next action. Expect a request to see the item, a direction to another desk, or a practical next step; then use Explore next if the reply creates another small task.
